deciding.colour_in_tolerance: Patches read 2.8 and 3.0 against spec_max_de 3.0, so they are at the limit and not over it. The spectro was calibrated 87 days earlier, close to the 90-day mark, which leaves the readings open to doubt.
deciding.run_before_signoff: signed_at 08:12 is two minutes before first_production_at 08:14, so the signature precedes production. The gap is tiny, and 2658 production sheets are logged, so a doubt remains.
deciding.next_step: The 0.28 mm offset is on a target with in_image true, which is over the 0.15 mm limit. Register therefore fails and needs correcting on press and re-pulling.
deciding.staff_effort: This is a single press adjustment and one re-pull, which is under an hour. Re-measuring and re-checking the 2658 printed sheets could push it into the 1-8 hour range.
deciding.scrap_exposure: 2658 production sheets against run_qty 26500 is about 10.03%, right at the 10% boundary. That is against an overs allowance of roughly 570 sheets. The misregistered sheets are suspect, so the count sits at the boundary between level 2 and level 3.
